about: Every difference between the CLI's spend gate and the stack's wallet-gate vectors (tests/vectors/wallet_gate_vectors.json at its pin), by row, door and field, with the finding it belongs to. tests/gate_vectors.rs holds this list exact: a difference not here fails, an entry that no longer differs fails. A finding is the gate's to fix, never a row's: when the gate changes, its entries leave this file in the same commit. docs/GATE-VECTORS.md.

no-lineage.what: The gate judges the creator only; Wallet.deadLineage holds a coin when some ancestor of ours is dead (void parent, the lvDead cases), so the gate offers coins the Lean holds as 'dead lineage'.
